sentences.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，可以幫我嗎？
sentences.tips: 「Excuse me」用於禮貌打擾或吸引注意；「Sorry」則是道歉，兩者場合不同，注意區分。

sentences.en: Excuse me, I'm a bit lost.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我有點迷路了。
sentences.tips: 「Excuse me」用於禮貌打擾或吸引注意；「Sorry」則是道歉，兩者場合不同，注意區分。

sentences.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you — do you know where the Central Market is?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，打擾一下——請問您知道中央市場在哪裡嗎？
sentences.tips: 「Excuse me」用於禮貌打擾或吸引注意；「Sorry」則是道歉，兩者場合不同，注意區分。

sentences.en: How do I get to the British Museum?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼去大英博物館？
sentences.tips: 詢問地點時，「Where is...?」問位置，「How do I get to...?」問交通方式，兩者皆實用。

sentences.en: Is the train station far from here?
sentences.zh: 火車站離這裡遠嗎？
sentences.tips: 在車站詢問月台時，Which platform for...? 是很實用的句型，搭火車前務必確認月台號碼。

sentences.en: Which way is Oxford Street?
sentences.zh: 牛津街往哪個方向？
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: Am I going the right way to Buckingham Palace?

sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: Is it within walking distance, or should I take a taxi?
sentences.zh: 走路到得了嗎，還是我應該搭計程車？
sentences.tips: 搭乘計程車前可先詢問 How much will it cost to...? 確認費用，避免糾紛。

sentences.en: Could you show me on this map how to get to the old town from here?
sentences.zh: 可以在這張地圖上告訴我，從這裡怎麼走到舊城區嗎？
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: Are there any landmarks I should watch out for so I know I'm on the right track?
sentences.zh: 有沒有什麼地標可以確認方向沒走錯？
sentences.tips: 在車站詢問月台時，Which platform for...? 是很實用的句型，搭火車前務必確認月台號碼。

sentences.en: I think I'm lost. Could you tell me where we are on this map?
sentences.zh: 我好像迷路了。可以告訴我我們現在在地圖上哪裡嗎？
sentences.tips: 遇到遺失或失竊時，說 I've lost my... 或 My ... has been stolen，向警察報案時需保留報案號碼以便保險申請。

sentences.en: My phone died and I can't use Google Maps — would you mind pointing me in the right direction?
sentences.zh: 我的手機沒電，沒辦法用Google Maps——可以麻煩您指一下方向嗎？
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: Could you repeat that, please?
sentences.zh: 可以再說一次嗎？

sentences.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit more slowly? I didn't catch the last part.

sentences.tips: 「Excuse me」用於禮貌打擾或吸引注意；「Sorry」則是道歉，兩者場合不同，注意區分。

sentences.en: Could you point it out on my map?

sentences.en: No worries, thank you anyway!
sentences.zh: 沒關係，還是謝謝你！

sentences.en: Would you mind showing me on my phone? I have Google Maps open — could you just drop a pin?
